action_items.task: Review the new project requirements regarding the target market and features.

decisions.text: The remote control will use standard buttons and basic functions suitable for elderly users.
The 'favorites' feature was dropped due to usability concerns for elderly users.
The 'back' button was dropped as it is too difficult for elderly users.
The remote will include a 'ten plus' button for channels above ten.
The remote will include a separate menu button.
The remote will include a mute button.
The remote's design will feature a unique shape or color to stand out.
The LED indicator for button activity will be red.
Buttons will light up when pressed and turn off after twenty seconds.
Teletext options will be kept on a single level of the remote.
Speech recognition feature is dropped from the remote control.

notes:
## Target Audience and Market Strategy
- The target market was changed to customers younger than forty, requiring the remote to be flashy and interesting.
- The design must stand out in the shop with a unique shape or color, similar to an iMac.
- The remote will be offered in different colors and potentially as a see-through option.
## Usability and Feature Selection
- The interface uses standard methods with simple standard buttons and basic functions suitable for elderly users.
- The 'favorites' feature was dropped because users might find it hard to remember which channel corresponds to which button.
- The 'back' button was dropped as it is too difficult for elderly users.
- Speech recognition was dropped due to usability issues and time constraints for market launch.
- Teletext options will remain on one level of the remote control.
## Design and Aesthetics
- The remote's design will feature a unique shape or color to stand out.
- The design should not look cheap despite the low price of 25 Euros.
## Button Feedback and Lighting
- The LED indicator for button activity will be red.
- Buttons will light up when pressed and turn off after twenty seconds.
- The lighting feature must only activate when the remote is used.
## Remote Control Features and Layout
- The remote will include a 'ten plus' button for channels above ten.
- The remote will include a separate menu button.
- The remote will include a mute button.
- The remote will include a teletext button.
tldr: The team designed a TV remote for a younger target market, featuring a unique shape, button lighting, and a red LED indicator. They dropped speech recognition and the 'favorites' feature to ensure usability and meet the 25 Euro price point.
